statement: Give the bulk discount from eight items instead of ten.
text:
# REQ-ORDER-DISCOUNT: Bulk discount

An order of eight or more items receives a 5% discount on its subtotal. An
order of fewer than eight items receives no discount. Items are counted across
all order lines.

## Examples

| Order lines | Discount | Total |
|---|---|---|
| 7 × 100.00 | 0.00 | 700.00 |
| 8 × 100.00 | 40.00 | 760.00 |
| 5 × 100.00 + 3 × 100.00 | 40.00 | 760.00 |
